name: SciDraw AI
tagline: AI scientific figure & illustration maker for research and teaching
description: SciDraw AI is a browser-based AI platform for creating scientific illustrations and data visualizations. Researchers, graduate students, and educators generate figures from text, sketches, or reference images, build charts from CSV/Excel with reproducible Python code, then refine results and export editable SVG, PDF, EPS, or TIFF for papers, posters, and teaching.
